text:
nina: quick — i'm drafting the internal RN + announce for Wed 09:00 PT maintenance (runtime patch). small, but want clear hold vs broadcast templates and a rollback snippet.
leo: drop the deploybot id and a one-liner rollback CLI. keep the blast super short.
nina: TL;DR draft:
- runtime v2.4.3 (kv-cache and batching fixes)
- canary: 4% x 20m -> 25% x 20m -> 100%
- no schema changes expected
leo: ops guardrails: abort if p95 > 200ms OR 5xx > 0.5% over 5m. fallback: pin to v2.3.2.
sre-oncall: i'll be oncall. i'll watch 1m/5m p95, 5xx, queue depth. escalate if p95>200ms. set alert: GPU util >85% for 3m.
deploybot: "scheduled deploy id db-20250305-2 by nina at 2025-03-05T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). canary policy: 4% -> 25% -> 100%. notify: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime"
leo: rollback snippet to include in RN:
```
# quick abort
deploybot cancel --id db-20250305-2 --reason "canary regression"
# console pin fallback
redwood console pin model common-model --version v2.3.2
```
nina: announce templates:
HOLD (if canary fails): "Team — scheduled runtime update failed canary checks. Pausing and rolling back to v2.3.2. SRE lead: @sre-oncall. Runbook: internal/release/db-20250305-2. Reply here for status."
BROADCAST (if canary ok): "Team — runtime v2.4.3 canary passed. Ramping to 100% now (T+40m). Watch p95 latency and 5xx rate. SRE lead: @sre-oncall. Release notes: docs/releases/2025-03-05."
leo: also add a short checklist for the poster: confirm canary metrics ok for 20m, then post broadcast to #eng-releases and #all-hands T+5m.
sre-oncall: i'll post preflight OK 15m before window. will own rollback if triggered and post updates here.
nina: i'll attach the runbook and RN link to the deploy ticket. publishing draft for review — please ack so i can finalize the two paste-ready blocks.
leo: ack. looks good. include product blurb link if public note is needed.
sre-oncall: ack. i'll be watching.
